$Comment: The Mastery Trainer, standing on the dais in the court of MMO Skill Tree's Adventurers' Hall, the
MMO's district in the temple hub, facing the hall's door. The trainer is this pack's character end
to end: their look, their role, this placement and the conversation pressing F opens all ship
here. Interact names a conversation rather than a screen, because the trainer has quests to hand
out and a word to say before the mastery menu. Author Open or Dialogue, never both.
Where names the hub's gameplay config, so the trainer stands in every hub copy and nowhere else.
Anchor is the hall's Mastery spot (Custom, Provider ziggfreedcommon:hub), so the trainer follows
the hall to whatever lot an owner moves it to and is absent when the hall stands nowhere. No
Parent on the temple standing: an Anchor group a child leaves out is inherited, so a child
would also look for the temple's spawn marker.
Requires keeps the trainer away until the mastery feature is switched on; Lifecycle keeps their
chunk loaded, puts them back if something removes them, and raises their health beyond anything
that can be dealt. This placement authors no Identity.NpcId, so the character IS its role: the
pack's mastery quests bind to Mmo_Mastery_Trainer, and their progress carries over from the
temple untouched. The trainer's temple standing, Mmo_Mastery_Trainer_Temple, ships switched off. To
take the trainer out without editing this file, set Enabled false in
Name: Mmo_Mastery_Trainer_Hall
